items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: all together a new band they had a little Gish was playing bass that's the brother of the big Gish that played alto saxophone... I'm traveling with them

ctx.x: And his first name? What was his first name? He said Little. It must have been a little and a big one.
No, that was Big Gish because they had Little Gish played bass. They were two brothers. Yeah. And the one they called Little Gish and the other one Big Gish.
Everybody in New Orleans has nicknames. I've always noticed that. What was your nickname on the boats? Cuz. Cuz. Why'd they call you Cuz? C-U-Z-Z? C-U-Z-Z. Yeah.
